title: Vegas Casinos Gave Away $3.8 Billion in One Year #shorts
summary: Clark County casinos recorded $3.76 billion of complimentaries (free rooms, food and drinks) in fiscal 2025; comped drinks were 41.4% of beverage revenue.
sources: Nevada Gaming Abstract, fiscal year 2025 (July 2024-June 2025), Clark County casinos: complimentary expense (contra revenue) $3,761,859,671; complimentary beverage sales 41.4% of beverage revenue: https://www.gaming.nv.gov/siteassets/content/about/abstract/abstract-fy-2025.pdf

scenes.narration: Las Vegas casinos gave away about {$3.8 billion|three point eight billion dollars} in one year.
Free rooms. Free dinners. And about four in every ten dollars of drinks.
Why? Because every hour you stay inside, the house edge keeps working.
Free drinks aren't free. They're how the house keeps you playing.
